pixelReview: All four original images were downloaded fresh and opened with view_image. They are current white-car references, not the old red design. Source photo bytes remain outside the repository and delivery.
visible: Shoulder and lower door edge rise toward the rear, creating a broad dark sill instead of a narrow rail.
The roof crest has a long shallow descent and connects to the rear body through substantial buttresses.
Wide closed black upper nose and an independent lower opening are real design features; front white cheeks and fenders are broad angular volumes.
Hood facets are intentional. The object is not an all-rounded sports-car body.
Rear photograph shows exposed upper metal outlets, lower ducts/fans, a continuous enclosing mouth, and thick body/cavity returns.
assumptions: No original CAD or lens calibration is provided; all model dimensions remain independent estimates.
Roof maximum height and width are initially held until evaluating the same fitted view. Camera fit uncertainty is kept separate from geometry.
No mass, inertia, tyre/wheelbase/track, nozzle or wing physics parameter changes are authorized by this appearance study.
